name: Book Block Calendar
description: Wall calendar with a photo and a month grid on each page. Pages flip like a book with 3D half-page folds and shadows, using arrow buttons or the keyboard.
contents: Twelve month pages, each with a photo, a month and year badge and a Monday-first day grid
Previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Pages flip horizontally in 3D around the middle fold with animated shadows
Arrow keys flip pages when keyboard is enabled
At the first or last page without circular mode, the page bounces back
Reduced motion preference shortens the flip
editableByProps: Year, photos, caption, size and photo-to-grid height split
Flip speed, shadows, circular looping and keyboard control
Page, text, line, button and caption colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the first day of the week or weekday labels
needsCodeEdit.where: WEEKDAYS_SHORT constant and the lead calculation in buildMonth

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the month badge style over the photo
needsCodeEdit.where: Month badge div with backdrop-blur-md inside the bb-item

fixed: Always shows twelve months, photos repeat if fewer than twelve are given
Listens for arrow keys on the document while keyboard is enabled and removes the listener on unmount
Flip uses a fixed horizontal fold with 1300px perspective
